response.sql: WITH equip_avgs AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_avg FROM equip_avgs), kept_equip AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity FROM equip_avgs WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_cte)), kept_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as kept_avg FROM kept_equip), results AS (SELECT ke.equipref, ke.avg_humidity, ke.avg_humidity - oa.overall_avg as exceeds_overall, ke.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg as differs_from_kept, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ke.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) as rn FROM kept_equip ke CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa CROSS JOIN kept_avg_cte ka WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND ka.kept_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, exceeds_overall, differs_from_kept FROM results WHERE rn <= 10 OR (rn > 10 AND differs_from_kept = (SELECT differs_from_kept FROM results WHERE rn = 10)) ORDER BY differs_from_kept DESC NULLS LAST

assumptions.assumption: NULLS LAST syntax is supported (PostgreSQL, SQLite, etc.; for MySQL/MariaDB, omit 'NULLS LAST' or use conditional logic since the filtering ensures non-NULL differs_from_kept values anyway)
Rows with NULL humepct in scanenvironment are excluded from the average calculations per the phrase 'ignoring missing readings'
If kept_equip contains fewer than 10 rows, all rows are returned (the tie-handling logic returns rn <= 10, which covers all available rows)

alternatives.interpretation: If ties at the 10th position are not desired and only exactly 10 rows should be returned, use LIMIT 10 without the tie-inclusion logic.
alternatives.sql: WITH equip_avgs AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_avg FROM equip_avgs), kept_equip AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity FROM equip_avgs WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_cte)), kept_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as kept_avg FROM kept_equip) SELECT ke.equipref, ke.avg_humidity, ke.avg_humidity - oa.overall_avg as exceeds_overall, ke.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg as differs_from_kept FROM kept_equip ke CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa CROSS JOIN kept_avg_cte ka WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND ka.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY differs_from_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
